# Secret field (`secret-field`)

Password / API key entry with reveal and copy.

Group: Text inputs. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/text-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createSecretField` (types in `dist/web/text-inputs/secretField.d.ts`): `.mh-input.mh-secret` (`--key` for API keys and tokens, in mono) inside a `.mh-field`: a password input with a reveal toggle (`aria-pressed`, eye icon) and an optional copy button that shows a check and announces the result in a polite live region. The text is never logged or put anywhere but the input and the clipboard.

```ts
export function createSecretField(options: SecretFieldOptions): SecretFieldHandle;

export interface SecretFieldOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`; the field then renders the box alone. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  value?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  kind?: SecretKind;
  name?: string;
  helper?: string;
  error?: string;
  success?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  readOnly?: boolean;
  size?: InputSize;
  labelStyle?: 'label' | 'eyebrow';
  /** A leading icon (decorative). */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** Starts with the text shown. */
  revealed?: boolean;
  /** Shows a copy button (default: true for `key`, false for passwords). */
  copyable?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name of the reveal toggle (default "Show password" or "Show key"). */
  revealLabel?: string;
  copyLabel?: string;
  /** Announced after copying (default "Copied"). */
  copiedText?: string;
  /** Announced when the clipboard refused (default "Couldn't copy"). */
  copyFailedText?: string;
  onInput?: (value: string, event: Event) => void;
  onChange?: (value: string, event: Event) => void;
  onReveal?: (revealed: boolean) => void;
  onCopy?: (ok: boolean) => void;
}

export interface SecretFieldHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  field: FieldHandle | null;
  revealButton: HTMLButtonElement;
  copyButton: HTMLButtonElement | null;
  getValue(): string;
  setValue(value: string): void;
  isRevealed(): boolean;
  setRevealed(revealed: boolean): void;
  /** Copies the value to the clipboard; resolves to whether it worked. */
  copy(): Promise<boolean>;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setSuccess(text: string | undefined): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}

export interface FieldHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  label: HTMLLabelElement | HTMLSpanElement;
  /** The described element (input, select, textarea or the control). */
  target: HTMLElement;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setSuccess(text: string | undefined): void;
  /** Updates the counter: `3 / 40` with a max, `3` without. */
  setCount(count: number, max?: number): void;
  /** Dims the label and messages (the control disables itself). */
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createSecretField } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const password = createSecretField({
  label: 'New password',
  kind: 'new-password',
  required: true,
  helper: 'At least 12 characters.',
  onInput: (value) => password.setSuccess(value.length >= 12 ? 'Long enough.' : undefined),
});

document.body.append(password.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { SecretField } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function SecretFieldExample() {
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  return (
    <SecretField
      label="New password"
      kind="new-password"
      required
      helper="At least 12 characters."
      success={password.length >= 12 ? 'Long enough.' : undefined}
      value={password}
      onValueChange={setPassword}
    />
  );
}
```
